risks.risk: Sale closes above/below the $5.4M / $10.9M Measure ULA cliffs, changing net proceeds by 4-5.5% of gross
risks.mitigation: Price/structure the sale knowingly vs thresholds; obtain Q04 jurisdiction determination; negotiate seller/buyer allocation; get CPA review pre-listing.

risks.risk: Cap-rate expansion (10Y at 4.88%) lowers the price buyers will pay for the NNN stream
risks.mitigation: Obtain opinion of value; test price at 5.5%-7.5% cap grid; sell only if price clears the owner's after-tax hurdle.

risks.risk: Prop 13 reassessment on buyer side suppresses future buyer pool / price
risks.mitigation: Nothing to mitigate — it's structural; price reflects it. Disclose accurately to avoid rescission claims.

risks.risk: Tenant credit deterioration disclosed late kills the deal or cuts price (SSS -1.1%, margin 37.4%)
risks.mitigation: Pre-negotiate estoppel + SNDA; seller provides full tenant financials; price in the risk up front.

risks.risk: Holding-period tax friction: no 1031 if replacement not identified in 45/180 days
risks.mitigation: Engage qualified intermediary before listing; pre-identify replacement candidates.

risks.risk: Renewal at flat/below-market rent locks in underperformance during 2030-2045
risks.mitigation: Benchmark rent to comparable QSR pads (G13); require fixed escalations ≥ inflation proxy; shorter initial term + options.

risks.risk: Tenant exercises closure ('JACK on Track') or goes dark mid-term; NNN rent stops
risks.mitigation: Guarantee + security deposit + continuous-operation clause; recapture rights on dark space; monitor quarterly 8-Ks.

risks.risk: Concentration: asset remains 100% of this line of wealth through another cycle
risks.mitigation: Size the position vs net worth; define a concentration cap (e.g., 25-35%); pre-commit to sell if exceeded.

risks.risk: Cost inflation outruns NNN escalations (CA min wage $16.90; fast food $20.00) pressuring franchisee solvency
risks.mitigation: Require sales reporting + covenant on occupancy cost %; escalate rent to CPI; verify franchisee-level EBITDA.

risks.risk: Hold-and-sell-at-expiry sells into an empty (dark) asset: negative carry, re-tenanting cost, value gap
risks.mitigation: Decide 12-24 months BEFORE expiry; market while tenanted; do not let the lease lapse unsigned.

risks.risk: Maintenance/CapEx surprises (roof, parking, signage, ADA) borne under a mislabeled 'NNN'
risks.mitigation: Get the lease's structural clauses read by counsel; renegotiate scope at renewal; reserve 1-2% of NOI/yr.

risks.risk: Extension-and-reprice negotiation fails or takes > 12 months, burning the decision window
risks.mitigation: Set a negotiation deadline; parallel-track a sale process quietly; use BATNA explicitly (G08).

risks.risk: Repriced rent is below the seller's aspiration, anchoring future sale pricing on a soft contract
risks.mitigation: Options structure (short base + options); include rent steps; commission appraisal before signing.

risks.risk: Demographic drag: county population -3.2% since 2020; retail sales per capita flat
risks.mitigation: Favor tenants with necessity-driven traffic; monitor QuickFacts annually; weight location vs trade-area income.

risks.risk: Employment softening in leisure/hospitality (EDD: -9,600 m/m Sep 2026) dents QSR sales locally
risks.mitigation: Track EDD monthly; trigger review if QSR-adjacent payroll trends turn negative for 2 consecutive months.

risks.risk: Interest-rate path resets yields; refinancing risk in the 2030-2035 window
risks.mitigation: Track DGS10 monthly; if > 5.5%, re-run pricing; keep hold debt fixed-rate and low leverage.

risks.risk: Property tax base resets on sale (Prop 13) — buyer's economics priced in; seller cannot avoid
risks.mitigation: n/a structural; factor into price expectations.

risks.risk: Insurance cost escalation erodes NNN math or tenant coverage lapses
risks.mitigation: Annual certificate-of-insurance verification vs lease requirements; lender-grade endorsements.

risks.risk: Major earthquake (60% M6.7+ in 30y; 46% M7.0+) damages the asset beyond deductible/coverage
risks.mitigation: CEA/DIC earthquake coverage review; seismic retrofit assessment where applicable; loss-of-rent insurance.

risks.risk: Wildfire disaster (2025 Palisades/Eaton paradigm) destroys insurability or the asset
risks.mitigation: Parcel FHSZ lookup (Q17); FAIR Plan + DIC fallback; defensible-space compliance; include wildfire deductible review in every decision pass.

risks.risk: Measure ULA expansion/re-indexation mid-hold raises transfer costs if the asset later sells in-city
risks.mitigation: Monitor July 1 ULA indexations; accelerate sale before adverse re-indexing if a sale is planned.

risks.risk: Systemic rate shock (DGS10 > 6.5-7%) gaps NNN cap rates down 100-150bps in months; forced sellers take the hit
risks.mitigation: Hard trigger: pause any sale process if DGS10 rises > 100bps in 90 days without price compensation.

risks.risk: Tenant bankruptcy / brand failure (system shrinking: -53 units y/y) leaves a dark pad in a soft market
risks.mitigation: Security, guarantee, continuous-operation covenant, recapture, quarterly tenant monitoring with written triggers (G05).

risks.risk: Trade/tariff shock collapses port throughput and LA trade jobs (Nov 2025 loaded imports -11%)
risks.mitigation: Track Port of LA monthly TEUs; if 2 consecutive months < -10% y/y, flag for downside case in the model.

risks.risk: Insurance-market failure: CA property insurance withdrawals make coverage unaffordable or unavailable
risks.mitigation: Annual broker check; FAIR Plan + DIC; lease passes premiums to tenant — verify enforcement.

risks.risk: Civil unrest / major local disruption destroys foot traffic near the site
risks.mitigation: Adequate property + business-interruption coverage tenant-side; monitor city public-safety data before final decision.

risks.risk: Climate/regulatory: extreme-heat and water-restriction mandates raise site operating costs or alter use rights
risks.mitigation: Annual review of LA DWP/city ordinances; ensure NNN structure passes costs to tenant.

risks.risk: Data risk: quiet use of stale or unofficial figures in the decision (cap rates, 'comps')
risks.mitigation: This workbook: every row source-linked or blank; verifier enforces; reviewer re-reads sources on decision day.

risks.risk: Process risk: decision made under 2030 pressure instead of on the 2026-2028 information we have now
risks.mitigation: Adopt the 12-24-month pre-expiry decision calendar (Q24); triggers listed on decision.html.

risks.risk: Regional macro shock: CA budget crisis/tax changes hitting commercial property and LA services (CA unemployment 5.1%)
risks.mitigation: Scenario overlay in model (downside case); keep liquidity reserve ≥ 6 months of asset costs.
